name: glass-cards
description: Liquid / frosted glass cards for Home Assistant dashboards. Fast, themeable without card_mod.

scripts.build: node scripts/demo-dashboard.mjs && tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && vite build && node scripts/copy-wallpapers.mjs && node scripts/write-version.mjs
scripts.build:web: node scripts/demo-dashboard.mjs && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts && mkdir -p dist-web/assets/vendor && cp wallpapers/hills-day.jpg dist-web/assets/wallpaper-hills-day.jpg && cp wallpapers/hills-night-blue-soft.jpg dist-web/assets/wallpaper-hills-night-blue-soft.jpg && (cd demo-assets && for f in *; do cp "$f" "../dist-web/assets/demo-$f"; done) && rm -rf dist-web/assets/vendor/* && (cd web/vendor && cp bubble-card.js layout-card.js apexcharts-card.js solar-arc-card.js ../../dist-web/assets/vendor/ 2>/dev/null || true)
